code_review: Exact registered data schema takes priority over descriptive modality; numeric loader accepts both documented data-schema names and the actual worker protobuf schema name.
MCAP first-datum anchoring retains native within-batch deltas; stable sorting moves samples with their timestamps and clipping is aligned.
Malformed channel layouts, partial timing, backwards native times and out-of-range mapped timestamps fail explicitly; RAM estimates use observed buffers rather than an unbounded duration sentinel.
Feature support bounds use actual first/last sample positions plus one nominal period; scaled reductions preserve finite large values; feature metadata labels provisional, uncalibrated results.
Dedicated handler records original source/stream IDs while encoded paths preserve distinct streams; inherited gap-builder source matches previously accepted main.
No production source was edited by the independent receiver.
decision: ACCEPTED: frozen numeric production source passes unchanged independent receiving
publication_status: Review binds exact source blobs; author publication and native CI acceptance are separate.
raw_preservation: Source tree SHA256 maps are compared before and after meaningful loader/job paths. MCAP and stream metadata remain unchanged.

scope_limits: Synthetic source-offline receiving only; no hardware, acquisition, live estate execution, calibration, or clock-drift fit claimed.
The RAM guard is an estimated materialization budget, not a process-memory hard limit.

Native CI, installation-wide JSON schema validation, and platform gates remain separate from this source/feature acceptance. Local jsonschema was absent and the normal dependency index had no distribution; no validator or schema was substituted.
